data.title: Add docket tags command to list all tags
data.body:
## Goal

Add a command to list all tags currently in use across bugs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket tags` lists all unique tags with bug counts
- [ ] Output shows tag name and how many bugs have it
- [ ] Sorted alphabetically or by count

## Context

Tags can be added with `docket tag` and filtered with `docket list --tag`, but there's no way to see what tags exist. A simple `docket tags` command would help discover available tags.

Example output:
```
0.2        (3 bugs)
backend    (5 bugs)
frontend   (2 bugs)
```

Low priority - tags work fine, this is just a discoverability improvement.
